subject: Request: senior authorization for hosted API volume concession
body:
From: Marta Silva <marta.silva@hyscore.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing ask — multi-region pilot and 36mo commit

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo. Hyscore is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the model variants for clinical summarization. We have a pilot that would scale into production across NA + EU regions, ramping to ~6M tokens/month inside 6 months. Procurement ran the numbers and asked whether we could get a 28% discount on hosted-API usage if we agree to a 12-month minimum commitment and a shared SLA addendum (24/7 SRE on-call, region pinning for EU).

Attached is a draft SOW and our internal pricing workbook. Please let us know if this is something you can escalate for senior sign-off; procurement needs a preliminary acceptance by EOD Monday to keep the timeline.

Best,
Marta Silva
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Hyscore

---
From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@hyscore.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing ask — multi-region pilot and 36mo commit

Marta — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I pulled the numbers with Ben and this request is beyond standard delegated discount authority; anything >20% requires senior approval.

Quick summary for escalation:
- External ask: 28% on hosted-API list usage rates
- Commitment: 12-month financial commit; 6M tokens/month expected ramp
- Asks: EU region pinning + 24/7 SRE support addendum
- Rationale: Strategic reference account in telehealth vertical; high likelihood of expansion to enterprise SKUs and dedicated capacity in 12–18 months

Ben, Mina — can you advise whether we have runway for a 25–30% concession with the proposed guardrails (term, doc changes, nested revenue clause)? Marta, I can escalate immediately if we have a go/no-go by tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
---
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pricing ask — multi-region pilot and 36mo commit

Aditya — I ran the economics. Baseline: at 6M tokens/mo the ARR impact is material; a 28% off list reduces unit revenue below our mid-range threshold unless we get a firm 12-mo committed spend and a step-up renewal clause. Ben notes:
- If legal requires EU data residency that could add infra delta; need extra 10–15% margin buffer or pass-throughs
- Approve up to 25% if customer signs: 12-mo minimum, DocuSign with auto-escalator (year 2 returns to list or 90% of list), and Redwood retains right to move to Dedicated with 90d notice if infra cost rises

Recommend we ask execs to approve 25% with those conditions; anything beyond 25% needs CRO-level sign-off.

-Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
---
From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing ask — escalation for senior authorization

Mina — looping you for senior authorization. Customer timeline is tight; procurement asked for a preliminary acceptance by Monday EOD. Key asks from Ben: 25% approval conditional on 12-mo commit, DocuSign automations, and rights to transition to Dedicated on cost changes. Also need legal to review the EU pinning + SRE addendum.

Forwarded message:
> From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
> To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@hyscore.ai>
> Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
> Subject: Hosted API pricing ask — multi-region pilot and 36mo commit
>
> (see thread)

Please advise — if you can clear 25% with the conditions, I will route DocuSign and confirm with the buyer. If you need greater concession, please specify exact approvals required and tradeoffs.

Thanks,
Aditya
---
From: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing ask — multi-region pilot and 36mo commit

Aditya/Ben — after reviewing the numbers and strategic signal from Hyscore, I approve a 25% hosted-API usage concession with the following mandatory conditions:
1) Execute a 12-month minimum financial commitment via DocuSign (no oral commitments).
2) Contract must include an auto-escalator for year 2 returning to at least 90% of list pricing (unless a new mutually agreed discount is signed).
3) EU region pinning is allowed only if Hyscore signs an infra pass-through clause for additional hosting charges tied to third-party cloud costs.
4) SRE on-call/addendum is limited to business hours SLAs for trial; full 24/7 SRE support to be evaluated as part of Dedicated discussion and invoiced separately.
5) Legal to sign off on SOW and data residency language prior to routing DocuSign.

Aditya — you have my sign-off to proceed at 25% with the above guardrails. Notify procurement and route the DocuSign link. If customer insists on 28% we will need CRO signoff (looping Erin if requested).

Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
